categories.name: Standard Procurement and Invoice Clearing
categories.description: Typical end-to-end purchase-to-pay variants involving order creation, receipt recording, invoice receipt, and successful invoice clearing with normal durations and low complexity.
categories.rationale: Represents the most frequent business paths (e.g. V0001, V0002, V0005) characterized by standard trace lengths and predictable cycle times.

categories.name: Short-Cycle or Early Deletion Variants
categories.description: Variants with very short trace lengths that terminate early, either successfully stopping at goods receipt without invoice processing or resulting in item deletion.
categories.rationale: Captures low-length paths such as simple purchase order creation (V0014), immediate deletion (V0009), or basic receipt without full invoice cycles (V0003).

categories.name: Service Entry and Rapid Execution
categories.description: Process variants that involve recording service entry sheets and goods receipts rapidly, often executed instantly via batch processing or short sequences.
categories.rationale: Grouped based on the presence of service entry sheets and zero or low median durations driven by batch automation (e.g. V0064, V0162, V0244).

categories.name: SRM Integration and Transfer Failures
categories.description: Procurement variants initiated through SRM systems that encounter complex transfer issues, multiple status transitions, and potential execution system failures.
categories.rationale: Distinctly marked by SRM-specific lifecycle events, state changes, and rare transfer failure outcomes (e.g. V2944, V2952, V2950).

categories.name: Extreme Rework and High-Duration Loops
categories.description: Outlier variants characterized by massive trace lengths, extensive repetition of invoice receipts, goods receipts, payment blocks, and invoice cancellations spanning multiple years.
categories.rationale: Clearly separated by extreme trace lengths (hundreds of steps), very high durations (thousands of days), and pervasive rework loops (e.g. V3680, V3305, V3102, V6776).
